title: Dry, observant Geraldine
description: Five static MIST expressions with uneven carved lids, shallower apertures, and compact mouths. Attentive and considering show the strongest drawn changes; skeptical and concerned retain much of the original favorite’s contour language.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one native raster concept sheet of five static MIST robot expressions, not animation frames.
Primary reference: the supplied original later-alligator-sweet-geraldine.png is the sole style and construction reference. Preserve its MIST skeleton: two free-floating cyan open-C eye masses and one small cyan mouth on a flat dark near-black field. Study the eye contour and negative opening language in that original. Make a corrected Sweet Geraldine direction that feels drier, observant, and understated. The personality difference must come from newly drawn contours, carved integrated lids, wider and shallower negative apertures, and mouth design; do not accomplish it merely by rotating the original shapes or varying stroke thickness.

Canvas/composition: landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels preferred at native generation size. Exactly five clearly separated faces in an invisible 3-column by 2-row grid. Place attentive at top-left, considering at top-middle, skeptical at top-right, amused at bottom-left, concerned at bottom-middle. Bottom-right cell entirely empty dark background. Match the original's sparse comfortable layout, same face scale family, generous cell margins, ample separation between eyes and mouth. No visible grid, no frames, no labels. Each face consists ONLY of two cyan eye contours/masses and one cyan mouth.

Shared style: flat solid pale turquoise-cyan closely matching the original favorite, without any emitted glow; flat uniform subtly green near-black background matching the favorite, smooth clean graphic edges with natural antialiasing. Retain the original's bold rounded open-C eye construction. Cyan eye masses surround open dark negative apertures; integrate any lid into the eye contour itself. Deliberately asymmetrical eyes with a mix of narrow and wider apertures and organic uneven contour mass as in the favorite. Avoid matching hoops and mechanically uniform outlines. Skeptical changes BOTH eye shapes; concerned has more closed, sloping eyes at unequal heights with a small frown. Use small crooked mouths where specified. A restrained, dry character whose eyes do most of the acting; mouth is compact and closed. The five emotion silhouettes must be meaningfully distinct.

Top-left ATTENTIVE: one broad attentive opening, the other eye with a gently lowered integrated upper lid and a shallower opening. The difference must read in the aperture shapes. A very restrained, compact shallow smile.
Top-middle CONSIDERING: one long narrow half-lidded aperture carved directly into the C-eye mass; other eye taller and more open-C. Clear unevenness communicates weighing options. A tiny bent or offset neutral closed mouth, visually different from skeptical.
Top-right SKEPTICAL: strong long LEVEL integrated upper lid in one eye, with a low broad narrow aperture; the other eye is a slightly lifted angular C with more exposed opening. Sharp dry side-eye attitude from the contours. A miniature closed down-slanted dash mouth.
Bottom-left AMUSED: mismatched relaxed laugh-squint C-eyes, one distinctly shallower than the other and both relaxed. A small closed lopsided smile, subdued amusement, no broad grin or open mouth.
Bottom-middle CONCERNED: inner upper edge raised WITHIN the eye contours, never as a separate eyebrow; lower and outer contours imply a downward gaze. A tiny shallow frown. Worried and tender rather than irritated or annoyed. Draw different concern contours than skeptical, with no aggressive pinched angry slant.

Strict constraints: exactly 5 faces, exactly 2 eyes and 1 mouth per face, static expression alternatives. No body, head outline, animal or human head, nose, cheeks, props, eyelashes, separate eyebrows, teeth, tongue, pupils, iris, text, letters, labels, watermark, glow, gradients, shadows, lighting effects, textures, pattern, atmosphere, extra marks or symbols. Do not add the alligator itself. Do not copy the original big open amused mouth. The source image only establishes MIST form language; draw this drier eye and mouth shape vocabulary freshly.
